name: ccx
description: ccx - claudecodex: sync task context between Claude, Codex, Antigravity and ZCode. Import a Claude Code session, Antigravity or ZCode conversation into this thread, keep them in sync, or hand this thread over. Menu bar ⇄ and the other apps' side: github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx

interface.shortDescription: Sync tasks: Claude, Codex, Antigravity, ZCode
interface.longDescription: Links a Codex thread with a Claude Code session and Antigravity and ZCode conversations so you can keep working on the same task in any of them: the others' new progress is brought into the conversation you are in. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or Z.ai.
